fields.label: Construction Method
fields.reminder: If manufactured take photos of HUD lables and cert.

fields.label: Electricity
fields.reminder: FHA: Take photo of working utility

fields.label: Water
fields.reminder: FHA: Take photo of utility/locate if well. Well ≥50 ft from septic tank, ≥100 ft from drain field.

fields.label: Sanitary Sewer
fields.reminder: FHA: Septic tank needs to be located on lot

fields.label: Utilities Notes/Repairs
fields.reminder: Extras/Adverse conditions? FHA: note standing water/improper grading (positive drainage required).

fields.label: Stories
fields.reminder: ANSI: A level is below-grade if any part of it is below grade.

fields.label: Foundation
fields.reminder: MDC: No basement/cellar space may be used as a habitable room. 17-26(5)

fields.label: Foundation Walls
fields.reminder: FNMA/FHA: settlement, water seepage, or cracking → document & photograph.

fields.label: Bedrooms
fields.reminder: FBC: Habitable room ≥70 sf · ≥7 ft min horizontal dimension. MDC rental sleeping room: ≥8 ft width.

fields.label: Ceiling Height
fields.reminder: ANSI: ≥7 ft ceiling (finished area). Sloped: ≥50% of room ≥7 ft; under 5 ft excluded.

fields.label: Attic
fields.reminder: FHA: Take pictures in attic. Note water stains, mold smell, or poor ventilation.
